Real Dogecoin mainnet blocks, unchanged, from github.com/dogecoin/libdohj
(core/src/test/resources/org/bitcoinj/core, commit 3dd6d7548843fe1891366e0325a05587eb21d1aa, Apache-2.0).
Each file is a full serialized block.

- dogecoin_block250000.bin: before AuxPoW (plain Scrypt block).
- dogecoin_block371337.bin: the first AuxPoW block (parent: a Litecoin block).
- dogecoin_block748634.bin: AuxPoW block.
- dogecoin_block894863.bin: AuxPoW block.
